svg.title: Hi-C map — three domains with endpoint compartment enrichment
svg.desc: A symmetric 20-by-20 Hi-C matrix with two short endpoint domains, one large central domain, subtle enrichment between the two endpoint A compartments, and a mirrored loop pair set far from the diagonal.
svg.metadata: Compartments: A3 B14 A3. Domain lengths: 3, 14, 3. Loop coordinates: (5,16) and (16,5), one bin inside the large domain corners. Symmetric deterministic noise seed: 3851473. Bin rectangles have no stroke and share exact numeric boundaries.
